MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQy.english: 'I,' said Mr. Wind, 'am stronger than you.'
'You're not,' said Mr. Sun, 'I'm stronger than you.'
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQy.chinese: 太阳先生，你不是，我比你更强。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQy.english: 'All right,' said Mr. Wind, 'see how hard I blow.'
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQy.chinese: '好啦，' 风先生说，‘看看我吹得多用力。'

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQy.english: 'Oh yes,' said Mr. Sun, 'I can make the plants grow.'
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQy.chinese: 太阳先生说：‘我能让植物生长。'

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQy.english: 'That man,' said Mr. Wind, 'I'll blow off his clothes.'
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQy.chinese: '那男人'， 风先生说，‘我来把他的衣服吹掉。'

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQy.english: 'Let's see,' said Mr. Sun, and behind a cloud he went.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQy.chinese: '看看吧'， 王先生说，并在云后面消失了。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQy.english: 'I'm cold,' said the man, 'I'll put on my scarf.'
'I told you,' said Mr. Sun, and he began to laugh.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQy.chinese: '我告诉过你了，'太阳先生说，然后开始笑。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQy.english: 'Your turn,' said Mr. Wind, 'I had mine.'
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQy.chinese: 轮到你了，风先生，我的是先来的。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQy.english: 'Okay,' said Mr. Sun, then he began to shine.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQy.chinese: 太阳先生说：‘好吧，’然后他开始发光。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQy.english: 'I'm hot,' said the man, 'I'll go swimming.'
And he took off his clothes.
'See,' said Mr. Sun, 'I win, Mr. Wind.'
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQy.chinese: 太阳先生说：‘我赢了，风先生。”'
